title: rosa lutea var. bicolor
intro: Rosa lutea var. bicolor, commonly known as the Yellow Rose or Mexican Gold Rose, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is known for its bright yellow flowers and is used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rosa lutea var. bicolor are believed to include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe and protect the skin, as well as reduce inflammation and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
